name: application-error-rate-sparkline-row
title: Error Rate Sparkline Row
description: API endpoint table with an inline error-rate trend sparkline and severity badge per row, driven by a typed rows prop contract.
useWhen: Monitoring the error rate of multiple API endpoints and needing a quick visual trend alongside the current rate.
Endpoints should be triaged by severity (healthy, warning, critical) at a glance across many rows.
A compact dashboard table is preferable to opening a separate chart per endpoint.
avoidWhen: You need generic numeric trends unrelated to error rates — use the Trend Sparkbar Row instead, which isn't tied to severity coloring.
Precise time-series analysis is required — pair this row with a full chart drill-down rather than relying on the sparkline alone.
There's only one endpoint to monitor — a single stat card communicates that more directly than a table.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its wrapping overflow container; the sparkline column keeps a fixed compact width regardless of table width.
accessibility: The sparkline bar series is marked aria-hidden since it is a decorative trend summary — the error-rate badge is the accessible source of truth.
Severity badges pair a color dot with an explicit percentage label, never color alone.
Endpoint identifiers (method + path) render in a monospace <code> element to read clearly as API routes.

variants.title: Error Rate Sparkline Row
variants.description: Endpoint table with a 24-hour bar trend colored by severity and a badge showing the current error-rate percentage per row.
accessibility: Severity is communicated through both badge color and an explicit percentage value, never color alone.

variants.title: Error Rate Sparkline Row (Dark)
variants.description: Error-rate monitoring table adapted for dark surfaces with the same sparkline and severity-badge structure.
accessibility: Severity bar and badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
